title: Nested declared-results if rotates an inherited slot and produces an unspendable branch
mechanism: The inner declared-results if performs ROLL+DROPs across the whole inherited arm. The outer reconcile checks only named-slot set and depth, so equal-depth paths with different middle-slot layouts pass its invariants; the continuation is emitted against the wrong layout.
consequence: The inner else-arm reaches the real Spend validator with an empty stack at OP_VERIFY and cannot spend. This is a valid source program that compiles but creates a wrongly unspendable output.
proposed_fix: Make lowerIf reconcile inherited slot order/layout, not only names and depth, then carry the same invariant and emitted layout into all seven tiers; retain this real-Spend reduction as a non-skipped test.

title: intentional-spec-change provenance is self-attested and accepts a golden restamp without a required spec witness
mechanism: The gate requires only path, content hash, category, free-form reason, and reviewer. intentional-spec-change is an allowed category, but no commit, spec path, section, diff, or independent oracle is checked. The bounded-loop IR entry is a concrete restamp: its reason cites #121 while the current semantics section still specifies count-only, zero-based loop lowering.
consequence: A wrong implementation can be regenerated, hash-pinned, and approved under the same category without an objective specification change. Seven-tier parity then only confirms shared output, not source semantics.
proposed_fix: Require intentional entries to pin an originating commit and spec section whose diff is non-empty, or require an independent executable/spec oracle; reject entries whose witness is absent or stale.

title: The skip lint gate is red on active TODO markers in a checked-in design document
mechanism: The composite gate scans docs/**/*.md for TODO/FIXME/XXX/todo!/unimplemented! markers, while its exclusions cover only self-references and runar-verification planning markdown. The design spec contains active TODO markers and is therefore rejected before the skip-site result is considered green.
consequence: The advertised CI gate cannot pass on this checkout even though the skip inventory itself reports every site documented. This masks the distinction between a real skip regression and an unrelated documentation marker.
proposed_fix: Remove the active markers or move deferred work to the tracker; if design documents are intentionally exempt, add a narrow documented exclusion and a separate check for executable/source skip surfaces.

title: Generated spend shapes do not express the nested declared-results inherited-layout shape
repro: rg -n 'declared-results|adopt|inherited arm|ROLL.*DROP' conformance/fuzzer/spend-shapes.ts; npx vitest run conformance/fuzzer/__tests__/spend-shapes.test.ts conformance/fuzzer/__tests__/spend-oracle.test.ts --reporter=verbose
mechanism: The generated family list covers branch merges, nested-if, loops, constructor slots, and state byte classes, but has no declared-results/adoption family that nests inside an enclosing arm while preserving live inherited slots. The dedicated Issue #149 reduction remains an explicit skipped fixture.
consequence: The generated spend gate can be green without ever generating the exact layout permutation that is still S1-broken. The branch-merged-local family is generated, but its own README documents that the quiet stale-state face is not reached for the reintroduced stack-misalignment mutation.
proposed_fix: Add a deterministic family for nested declared-results with inherited sibling slots, both inner arms, outer taken/else paths, and post-join reads; require real Spend plus post-state assertions.

title: State-framing fix has no replayable fuzz-regression entry
repro: find conformance/fuzz-regressions/entries -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort; rg -n 'state.?fram|state-push|OP_N-range|1-byte' conformance/fuzz-regressions/entries
mechanism: The replay corpus contract says each discovered bug is permanently replayed, but the entries directory contains no state-framing/state-push-framing entry. The fix is covered by a direct VM test and SDK-output fixture, while the fuzz corpus has only unrelated byte/shift entries and a branch K=1 entry.
consequence: A future encoder/decoder reintroduction of the one-byte state-section framing mismatch can pass the permanent fuzz replay gate; paired SDK round trips can also remain self-consistent while disagreeing with the locking script.
proposed_fix: Promote a minimized state-framing reproducer with pinned encoder bytes, script-decoded bytes, continuation result, and required-opcode/fixture guards into fuzz-regressions.

title: Go-only Merkle verification has only repository-generated vectors and no independent KAT authority
mechanism: merkle-proof is explicitly allowlisted to Go, making tier parity vacuous for this primitive. Its positive and negative vectors are generated locally from a local SHA-256 pair hash and seeded leaves; no upstream Merkle domain-separation or leaf-encoding KAT is consumed.
consequence: A shared or Go-only mistake in leaf hashing, pair ordering, domain separation, or proof-index interpretation can make every configured conformance result agree while no external authority detects it.
proposed_fix: Add upstream or independently authored Merkle KATs that pin leaf encoding, pair domain separation, ordering, empty/odd trees, and rejection cases; keep local property vectors as supplementary coverage.

title: Lean capstone treats the OP_PUSH_TX binding blob as opaque and axiomatizes its on-chain effect
mechanism: The Lean Stack evaluator models rawBytes as an opaque data push, so it cannot execute the injected 760-byte checkPreimage blob. The two stateful acceptance properties are axioms whose truth is delegated to the TS code generator and BSV Spend execution; the crypto_call residue path is likewise an allowed structural trust-base dependency.
consequence: If codegen emits a malformed binding blob, or the runtime interpretation differs from the axiom, Lean can still prove accept/reject agreement while a wrong transaction preimage is accepted or a valid continuation is rejected. Only the external execution tests exercise this boundary.
proposed_fix: Reduce the opaque boundary by proving/parsing the emitted blob's relevant opcode semantics, or make the runtime Spend test a mandatory independent gate with exact preimage-binding and negative-preimage cases for every stateful template.

title: fold-on allowlist accepts stale/nonexistent fixture names
mechanism: loadFoldOnAllowlist validates that each entry has a string fixture and non-empty reason, and foldOnSkipReason matches only the requested fixture/format. No loader or audit checks that the fixture exists, that the entry was used, or that it is still a fold divergence.
consequence: A stale entry can remain green and silently evade the fold-on verification path for nothing, while reviewers see a populated allowlist and cannot tell that it protects no live fixture.
proposed_fix: Validate every allowlist fixture against discovered conformance fixtures, reject duplicate/unmatched entries, and require a test or report proving each entry was consumed by a fold-on run.
